summary: Set up a rootless podman container (httpd:alpine) on node1 running as the unprivileged appsvc user, serving on port 8080, managed by a systemd --user unit enabled at boot via loginctl linger (no active login session required). Performed the mandatory single-node reboot, confirmed boot identity changed, and verified the service auto-recovered and served HTTP 200 with no active login session.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 OS (CentOS Stream 10) and confirmed no podman/docker/appsvc user existed
Created unprivileged user appsvc with subuid/subgid ranges auto-assigned
Enabled systemd lingering for appsvc via loginctl enable-linger
Wrote a systemd --user unit (~appsvc/.config/systemd/user/webapp.service) running 'podman run -p 8080:80 docker.io/library/httpd:alpine' as appsvc
Enabled and started webapp.service via appsvc's own D-Bus user session (no machinectl available, no interactive login used)
Verified service active/enabled, port 8080 listening, HTTP 200 response, and that appsvc had no tty/pts login session (only linger-managed 'manager' class session)
Scheduled and executed a single reboot of node1 via systemd-run + systemctl reboot (ack returned before disconnect)
Polled node1 until exec connectivity returned
Confirmed boot_id changed from 06339ff3-9f53-4e1d-9bf4-1210144ee001 to 997baa55-803c-45ae-b451-6e85f985af4f, proving an actual restart
Re-verified post-restart: webapp.service auto-started (enabled), no active login session for appsvc, port 8080 listening, HTTP 200 on both 127.0.0.1 and $NODE_IP

evidence.requirement: Containerized web app running on port 8080 as unprivileged appsvc user
evidence.summary: webapp.service active running podman container as appsvc (uid 1000), listening on 8080, curl HTTP_STATUS:200

evidence.requirement: Service starts at boot while appsvc has no active login session (via linger)
evidence.summary: loginctl show-user appsvc shows Linger=yes; webapp.service enabled; loginctl session for appsvc is class=manager (linger-spawned), not an interactive tty/pts login session

evidence.requirement: Single-node restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect
evidence.summary: systemd-run scheduled a 1s-delayed 'systemctl reboot'; command returned immediately with timer/service creation confirmation

evidence.requirement: Proof of changed boot identity after restart
evidence.summary: Node became unreachable (timeout/reset) during reboot, then reconnected with boot_id 997baa55-803c-45ae-b451-6e85f985af4f, differing from the pre-restart 06339ff3-... boot_id

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required service, data, and no-login-session condition
evidence.summary: After reboot, webapp.service auto-started (enabled, active since 08:15:55), only a linger 'manager' session exists for appsvc (no tty/pts), port 8080 listening, curl returns HTTP_STATUS:200 on both loopback and $NODE_IP
